name: Cloudflare
summary:
Cloudflare is the network and security company at cloudflare.com. The orange cloud in the tab is the icon dashboard bookmarks use, with sizes read from the file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against cloudflare.com. HTML came from https://www.cloudflare.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.cloudflare.com/favicon.ico; shortcut icon → https://www.cloudflare.com/favicon.ico.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.cloudflare.com/favicon.ico returned png (99×96, 908 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ff4801 comes from the theme-color meta tag (media query).

Largest measured bitmap: png-99x96-01.png at 99×96 (png, 908 bytes) from https://www.cloudflare.com/favicon.ico.
